speaker: Doctor
text: I will start by asking: How long have you been experiencing this pruritic rash on your palms, and has the numbness or tingling sensation worsened over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis (specifically Visceral Leishmaniasis or Diffuse Cutaneous Leishmaniasis with neurological involvement, given the rice farming context and systemic symptoms). I request a COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT, LEISHMANIA ANTIGEN SCREEN, and BONE MARROW BIOPSY. Please confirm if you have any weight loss, fever, or night sweats alongside these symptoms.
